ShortDescription.Value: Hide different Ui elements, when not hovering over it. Now Includes Show Text Trend by DanielVNZ and New Tooltips for Money, Population and Demand

Publish.LongDescription:
Beyond Numbers hides the population number on the city toolbar unless the player hovers over it (Need to be activated in Settings). It also hides the demand bars and Time information in a similar manner (can be activated in the settings). This helps reduce stress when building a detailed city, as the raw numbers are only shown when you actually want to see them.
**Features:** Everything in this Mod can be Activated/Deactivated in the Settings
- **Hide Population Number:** The population count is not hidden by default. - **Hide Demand Bars:** Optionally hide the demand bars (Residential, Commercial, Industrial) until hovered. - **Hide Time of day:** Optinal you can Hide these to reduce stress when building detail as it doesnt show how long you have been detailing in the current game Session. - **Hide Current Year:** Optinal you can Hide these to reduce stress when building detail as it doesnt show how long you have been detailing in the current game Session. - **Population Trend Overlay:** A subtle balloon indicator shows whether your population is growing or shrinking — without showing the exact number. - **Population Trend Tooltip:** Hovering over the population number shows a tooltip with the monthly trend of your city’s population. - **Money Trend Overlay:** A similar overlay shows the trend of your city’s budget over time, so you stay informed without feeling pressured. - **Money Trend Tooltip:** Hovering over the money icon shows a tooltip with the monthly trend of your city’s budget. - **Show Text Trends integration:** The functionality of the “Show Text Trends” mod is now built directly into Beyond Numbers, combining both mods into one. - **Demand Bar Tooltip:** Hovering over the demand bars shows the demand and the strongest demand factors of every zone type. - **Compact Number Format:** Large numbers are shortened (e.g. 1.50M) and use the separators of your game language. - **In-game Settings Panel:** Change every setting in-game in a panel with tabs. Open it with the button or with Ctrl+B (can be changed). - **Fully configurable:** All overlays and hiding behaviors can be toggled independently in the mod settings.
**Translations:** Beyond Numbers is translated on Crowdin. Help translate it into your language here: https://crowdin.com/project/beyond-numbers
Special Thanks to DanielVNZ for who originally created the “Show Text Trends” mod, which has now been merged into Beyond Numbers.
If you have any feedback or suggestions, please let me know in the forum thread or on the Discord modding server: https://discord.gg/HTav7ARPs2
The Thumbnail is based on the Thumbnail Style by Luca (The mod Author of Platter). I had a chat with Luca and got his permission to use the Thumbnail Style for Beyond Numbers.
Big thanks to Honu/River-mochi for helping me.
Publish.ChangeLog:
**New: Beyond Numbers Settings Panel** - All Beyond Numbers settings can now be changed in-game in a panel, without opening the options menu. Changes apply and save straight away. - The panel is split into tabs: Visibility, Trends, Money Tooltip, Population Tooltip and Demand Tooltip. - The button that opens the panel can sit in the Universal Mod Menu, at the top left or at the top right (new setting "Panel Button Location"). - New keyboard shortcut to open and close the panel: Ctrl+B by default. You can change it in the settings, and "Reset Key Bindings" brings back the default. The shortcut only works in-game. - Settings that City Watchdog takes over are marked in the panel as disabled.
**New: Demand Bar Tooltip** - Hovering over the demand bars now shows the demand and the demand factors of every zone type (residential low/medium/high, commercial, industrial, office), like the City Information panel does. - Each part can be switched on or off: demand values in percent, the strongest positive and negative demand factors, and the numeric weight of each factor (off by default). - A master switch turns the whole demand tooltip on or off at once. - Zone types that are still locked in your city are left out of the tooltip. - This tooltip also works when City Watchdog is installed, because City Watchdog doesn't change the demand bars.
**New: Compact Number Format** - Large numbers in the Beyond Numbers trends and tooltips are shortened, e.g. 1,500,000 becomes 1.50M and 2,300,000,000 becomes 2.30B. Numbers below one million are always shown in full. - Numbers now use the separators of your game language (e.g. 1.234.567 in German). - Turned on by default. You can switch it off under Visibility.
**New: Translations via Crowdin** - Beyond Numbers can now be translated on Crowdin into every language the game supports: German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Chinese (Simplified) and Chinese (Traditional). - German is already included. Text that isn't translated yet is shown in English. - Anyone can help translate in the browser, no coding needed: https://crowdin.com/project/beyond-numbers
**Improvements** - City Watchdog detection is faster. It runs once instead of on every check, which saves work in the settings and the UI. - The settings panel is wider, so the longer option names fit.
**Bug fixes** - Fixed City Watchdog sometimes not being detected when it loaded after Beyond Numbers. Trends and tooltips could then show up twice.
